description: Windows-1252 text in the 0x80-0x9F range that Latin-1 leaves as C1 controls
notes: 0x93/0x94 are the curly double quotes, 0x80 the euro sign, 0x97 an em dash. Decoding this as ISO-8859-1 yields control characters instead: the single most common mojibake source, and why both encodings are named rather than guessed.
